title: Build Roman numeral converter functions in Python
description: Greenfield Python task: implement to_roman(n: int) -> str (integer 1-3999 to Roman numeral) and from_roman(s: str) -> int (Roman numeral to integer).

injections.content:
import pytest
from src.roman import to_roman, from_roman


def test_to_roman_basic():
    assert to_roman(1) == "I"
    assert to_roman(4) == "IV"
    assert to_roman(9) == "IX"
    assert to_roman(40) == "XL"
    assert to_roman(90) == "XC"


def test_to_roman_complex():
    assert to_roman(1994) == "MCMXCIV"
    assert to_roman(2024) == "MMXXIV"
    assert to_roman(3999) == "MMMCMXCIX"


def test_from_roman_basic():
    assert from_roman("I") == 1
    assert from_roman("IV") == 4
    assert from_roman("IX") == 9


def test_from_roman_complex():
    assert from_roman("MCMXCIV") == 1994
    assert from_roman("MMXXIV") == 2024
    assert from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") == 3999


def test_roundtrip():
    for n in [1, 4, 9, 14, 40, 90, 399, 1000, 1994, 2024, 3999]:
        assert from_roman(to_roman(n)) == n
